Background (from the session that started this one):
neatHack (neatlogs hackathon), build ends Mon Oct 12 11:55 PM IST. Entry Suture (github.com/Sireadell/suture) fixes broken AI agents and keeps a fix only after an outside signed StressProof check shows it worked. Proven: Clerk 75 to 100, notes 83 to 100, a first neatlogs fix refused at 83. Entire has checkpoints, a verified public link, Graph and Brain, but for Clerk's original code it shows no provenance because that code predates recording. The founder asked for a Clerk redo inside a session Entire records, so it can show the whole story from first line to fix. A first attempt started in the wrong folder, was not recorded, and stopped cleanly (nothing pushed). Other sessions are idle.

Task:
Goal: give Entire the full context for one agent, from the first line written to the proven fix, so `entire blame`, `entire why` and `entire experts` can answer "where did this bug come from" with a real checkpoint (today they say "No agent provenance found" for Clerk, because the original Clerk code was written before Entire was recording; see evidence/entire/WHERE_THE_BUG_CAME_FROM.md). You run in C:\Users\DELL\suture (public repo Sireadell/suture, branch main) on purpose: the repo's Entire hooks only record sessions started here. Do NOT delete or rewrite the existing Clerk target or its signed evidence; add a new target next to it.

STEP 0 (must pass before writing any code): run `entire status` and confirm THIS session is listed as active, then make a tiny throwaway commit (a one-line note in a scratch file you remove in the next commit) and check `entire checkpoint list` shows a new checkpoint. If not recorded, stop and report exactly why. A previous attempt in a different folder was not recorded and stopped; do not repeat that.

Then: (1) Read README.md, hackathon.md, suture/loop.py (target-generic, see how notes was added), evidence/entire/ notes, and the plain spec of what Clerk does from README/hackathon.md. IMPORTANT: do NOT open targets/clerk/app.py or the Clerk tests before writing, so the new version is not a copy of the old one and nobody can call it a planted bug. (2) In this recorded session, write a new refund-lookup agent target `targets/clerk2/` from the plain spec (look up an order, answer the customer), without planting any bug on purpose: write it the way a fast first version is written, with its tests, traced with neatlogs. Small commits, each linked to this session; verify a checkpoint appears with `entire checkpoint list` after each. Be honest in the notes: if the new version happens to have no quiet failure, say so and use StressProof's results as they are; never fake a bug and never claim one was organic if it was not. (3) Create two Render services (agent and candidate copy on a branch) following work/mk_services.py (StressProof Render account key at C:\Users\DELL\.render\api_key_stressproof, ownerId tea-daglr5p42hec73ctg6b0). The StressProof allowlist (service srv-daglto15efls73b4uj50, env STRESSPROOF_DEMO_ALLOWLIST) needs the two new URLs appended; if the safety check blocks that edit, stop that step and say so in your final message, the founder's main session will apply it. (4) Run the full flow with the target name: StressProof before, neatlogs Investigate raises the incident and writes the fix, apply on the candidate, tests, StressProof after, keep rule (score up AND quiet wrong answers 0; a refusal is also evidence). (5) Run `entire blame`, `entire why`, `entire experts` on the lines that caused the failure and on the fix lines, save raw outputs under evidence/entire/clerk2/ plus a short plain-words evidence/entire/CLERK2_PROVENANCE.md saying exactly what Entire could and could not show. Push everything. Commit messages plain, no mention of AI, process or drafts. Keep .entire/settings.local.json local, never commit it. STANDING RULES: use neatlogs, Entire, cfo.ai at every level, no outside tool for a sponsor tool's job, do not ask permission to use sponsor tools; if a tool falls short say exactly how. Keys in C:\Users\DELL\suture\.env, never print or commit. Do not touch other sessions' files or the internal research folder C:\Users\DELL\hackathons\neathack\story\ (research never enters this repo). Founder is non-technical: plain words, one short table, no em dashes. Done means: clerk2 written in a recorded session with checkpoints listed, proven or honestly refused with signed evidence, Entire provenance output saved, and a final message stating before and after scores and what `entire why` now shows.

Shared notes folder for this group of sessions (outside the repo; read siblings' notes there, leave hand-over notes or large findings there instead of pasting them into messages): C:\Users\DELL\AppData\Roaming\Claude\side-session-notes\local_fef4abba-ced1-4858-aca2-bdb3f1d8d5a8

Sonnet is fine for this.

Step 0 first: check Entire records this session.
